say:2:1530139701:1.text: Our true goddess abandoned us, but the false one saved us...
say:2:1530139701:1.source_cn: 我们的神背弃了我们，伪神却救下了我们……
say:2:1530139701:1.male: Our true goddess abandoned us, but the false one saved us...
say:2:1530139701:1.female: Our true goddess abandoned us, but the false one saved us...

say:3:1530139702:1.text: Who could've imagined it would end up like this?
say:3:1530139702:1.source_cn: 谁能想到，最后竟然是这个样子。
